342: ## Requirement Mappings
343: 
344: Mappings link an FR to one or more TRs and TEST IDs in the current workspace, forming the traceability matrix.
345: 
346: ### Listing Mappings
347: 
348: ```yaml
349: type: request
350: payload:
351:   requestId: req-20260409T120011Z-listmap-001
352:   method: workflow.requirements.listMappings

357: ### Creating a Mapping
358: 
359: ```yaml
360: type: request
361: payload:
362:   requestId: req-20260409T120012Z-createmap-001
363:   method: workflow.requirements.createMapping
364:   params:
365:     frId: FR-MCP-001
366:     trIds:

368:     testIds:

402: ## Document Generation
403: 
404: To generate formatted requirements documents from the current workspace database slice:
405: 
406: ```yaml
407: type: request
408: payload:
409:   requestId: req-20260409T120014Z-gendoc-001
410:   method: workflow.requirements.generateDocument
411:   params:
412:     format: markdown
413:     docType: matrix
414: ```
415: 
416: Valid `docType` values:
417: 
418: - `functional` - numbered list of all FR entries with status and description
419: - `technical` - numbered list of all TR entries grouped by area/subarea
420: - `testing` - numbered list of all TEST entries with linked FR IDs
421: - `matrix` - traceability matrix table: FR × TR × TEST × status
422: - `all` - complete export package

441: ### Wiki Export
442: 
443: Use `format: wiki` with `docType: all` to export wiki files directly into the workspace. The normal result returns metadata, not archive bytes. Files are written under `docs/Project/wiki/azure` and `docs/Project/wiki/github`. Each folder includes `.mcp-requirements-manifest.json`; Azure also includes `.order`; GitHub also includes `_Sidebar.md` and `_Footer.md`. When an older REPL cannot serialize the metadata result, the wrapper may return `contentBase64` with `contentType: application/json`; decode it to read the same export metadata.

471: ## Bulk Ingestion
472: 
473: To import requirements from an existing Markdown document:
474: 
475: ```yaml
476: type: request
477: payload:
478:   requestId: req-20260409T120015Z-ingest-001
479:   method: workflow.requirements.ingestDocument
480:   params:
481:     content: |
482:       ## FR-MCP-010: GraphRAG ingestion
483:       The system must support ingestion of raw text into the GraphRAG corpus.
484:       Priority: high | Area: MCP | Status: pending
485: 
486:       ## TR-MCP-GRAPH-001: Chunked text embedding
487:       Ingested text must be split into chunks and embedded using all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
488:       Priority: high | Area: MCP | Subarea: GRAPH | Status: pending
489:     format: markdown
490: ```
491: 
492: To import wiki documents, pass a path-keyed `documents` map and include `lastModifiedUtc` per entry when available. Use `sourceFormat: auto` or `wiki`; set `preferredWikiFormat: azure|github` only when the Azure and GitHub timestamp checks disagree. The server compares both `.mcp-requirements-manifest.json` `generatedAtUtc` values and the latest `lastModifiedUtc` per platform. If both checks agree, the newer platform is selected. If they disagree and no preference is supplied, import fails. The selected platform folder is authoritative: missing records are deleted, changed records are updated, new records are created, and identical records are ignored.
493: 
494: ```yaml
495: type: request
496: payload:
497:   requestId: req-20260409T120015Z-ingest-wiki-001
498:   method: workflow.requirements.ingestDocument
499:   params:
500:     format: wiki
501:     sourceFormat: wiki
502:     preferredWikiFormat: github
503:     documents:
504:       github/.mcp-requirements-manifest.json:
505:         content: '{"generatedAtUtc":"2026-04-09T12:00:14Z"}'
506:         lastModifiedUtc: 2026-04-09T12:00:14Z
507:       github/Functional-Requirements.md:
508:         content: |
509:           # Functional Requirements (MCP Server)
510:         lastModifiedUtc: 2026-04-09T12:00:15Z
511: ```
512: 
513: The server parses the document, creates, updates, deletes, or ignores matching FR/TR/TEST/mapping records, and returns a summary:
514: 
515: ```yaml
516: type: result
517: payload:
518:   requestId: req-20260409T120015Z-ingest-001
519:   result:
520:     created: 2
521:     updated: 0
522:     skipped: 0
523:     errors: []
524: ```

526: ## Error Handling
527: 
528: Common error codes:
529: 
530: - `requirement_not_found` - no requirement with the given ID
531: - `requirement_already_exists` - ID already in use; update instead of create
532: - `invalid_requirement_id` - ID does not match the expected regex for its type
533: - `mapping_not_found` - mapping between the specified FR and TR does not exist
534: - `invalid_mapping` - mapping references a non-existent FR, TR, or TEST ID
535: - `document_generation_error` - failed to render the requested document format
536: - `document_ingestion_error` - could not parse or persist the ingested document
537: 
538: ## Workflow Recommendations
539: 
540: When discovering or agreeing on new requirements during a session:
541: 
542: 1. Create the FR record immediately using `workflow.requirements.createFr`
543: 2. Create the corresponding TR records using `workflow.requirements.createTr`
544: 3. Create the TEST record using `workflow.requirements.createTest`
545: 4. Link them with `workflow.requirements.createMapping`
546: 5. Include the new IDs in the session log turn tags via `workflow.sessionlog.updateTurn`
547: 
548: Capture requirements as they emerge; do not defer to end of session. Requirements traceability is validated in CI and build failures result from missing mappings.
